name: Panama Disease (Fusarium Wilt)
description: A soil-borne fungal disease that causes wilting and death of plantains and bananas. Tropical Race 4 (TR4) is a severe strain threatening global production. The fungus persists in soil for decades.
symptoms: Yellowing of lower leaves starting from leaf margins
Leaves collapsing at the petiole, hanging down around the stem
Vascular discoloration visible when cutting pseudostem cross-section
Plant death within weeks to months of first symptoms
causes: Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cubense fungus
Movement of infected soil, water, or plant material
treatments: No effective chemical treatment once infected
Remove and destroy entire infected plants including roots
Apply Trichoderma-based biocontrol to surrounding plants
Quarantine affected area to prevent spread
prevention: Avoid moving soil or plant material from infected areas
Disinfect tools and boots when moving between fields
Implement strict quarantine measures for TR4-affected areas
